This chain of interactions implies that Jerantinine A may influence the activity of DNMT3A2/3L, potentially affecting the transport function of Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3. The presence of a final score of 0.5589 indicates a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, though further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct interaction and functional role of Jerantinine A in this pathway. The evidence highlights a mechanistic link between the compounds through a well-defined target network, suggesting a possible role in modulating transporter activity.
